protocol.cohort: Repeatedly evaluated ICU100; exploratory, one training seed; no metric/threshold-based weight selection
protocol.filtering: Unchanged strict signed thresholds; separate-sign 8-connected CC >250*image_area/512^2
protocol.one_to_many: (matched model regions + matched reference regions)/(model regions + reference regions); each region counts once if any same-sign partner overlaps or touches (8-neighbours)
protocol.one_to_one_presentation: Overlap-only greedy matching, model-first; same order as presentation reference
protocol.one_to_one_legacy: Overlap-only greedy matching, reference-first; reproduces the previous OV table
protocol.aggregation: Pool counts over pairs and both signs for each reader; then mean/sample SD across five readers
protocol.empty_handling: Presentation ratios: empty/empty=1. Legacy OV undefined empty/empty remains null.
protocol.annotation_policy: Original rasterization unchanged; warnings counted explicitly, not proof of annotation validity
protocol.execution: CPU-only saved-prediction rescoring; no model construction, inference, training or input modification
protocol.publication: Aggregates only: no patient/case IDs, images, annotations, paths, predictions or weights
